unreachable: The server is unreachable. Try again later.
conflict: The record conflicts with an existing one.
aresUnavailable: ARES is unavailable. Try again later.
documentLocked: An issued document can no longer be changed.
invalidState: This action is not possible in the document's current state.
cnbUnavailable: The ČNB exchange rate service is unavailable. Enter the rate manually.
advanceSettled: The payment cannot be deleted: its advance payment tax document is already deducted by an issued final invoice.
advanceInUse: The payment cannot be deleted: its advance is deducted by a draft final invoice, or its advance payment tax document has a correction. Remove the advance line from that draft, or delete / cancel the correction first.
catalogItemInUse: The item cannot be deleted: it is the only item of a group. Edit or delete the group first.
pdfUnavailable: The PDF service is unavailable. Try again later.
storageUnavailable: The file storage is unavailable. Try again later.
pdfRenderFailed: Rendering the PDF failed. Check the design template.
tooLarge: The file is too large (20 MB at most).
categoryInUse: The category cannot be deleted because documents use it. Deactivate it instead.
numberTaken: The allocated number is already used by an imported document. Set the number series counter in Settings.
exceedsOriginal: Cannot cancel: the credit notes would exceed the original document plus its debit notes for some VAT rate.
smtpFailed: Sending the e-mail failed – the SMTP server rejected the message or is unreachable.
smtpNotConfigured: E-mail sending is not configured (no SMTP server in the configuration).
emailDisabled: Sending e-mails is temporarily disabled on this instance.
templateInvalid: The e-mail template contains an error.
forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
csrf: The request was refused (invalid origin). Reload the page and try again.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
busy: The server is busy right now. Please try again in a moment.
spaceCreationDisabled: Creating new spaces is disabled on this instance.
spaceLimit: You already own the maximum number of spaces you can create. Delete one, or ask to be invited into an existing space.
lastOwner: The only owner cannot be removed or leave the space. Make another member an owner first.
mfaRequired: This space requires two-factor authentication, which your account does not have. Turn it on in your account on the main site and sign in again.
emailTaken: An account with this e-mail address already exists. Sign in and accept the invitation again.
quotaExceeded: The storage quota is used up.
designInvalid: The design cannot be rendered – nothing was changed.
draftEmpty: The draft is empty – there is nothing to activate.
designBusy: Another design change is in progress. Try again in a moment.
draftChanged: The draft changed during activation. Check it and activate again.
versionIncomplete: The files of this version are missing from the storage – it cannot be restored.
emailRateLimited: The e-mail limit (per hour or per day, for this space or for you) is used up. Try again later.
emailRateLimitedWait: The e-mail limit (per hour or per day, for this space or for you) is used up. Try again in {wait}.
